name: wowwed
description: WowWed monorepo — run scripts from the project root

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=5002 npm run dev --prefix backend" "cross-env PORT=3001 BROWSER=none REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:5002 npm start --prefix frontend"
